memory_model.notes: Transpiles to Python; relies on Python's reference-counting + cycle GC. mllang is immutable-leaning at the source level (no mutable bindings, no `ref` cells in v1), so most program-visible aliasing is naturally shallow.

design_notes: Hand-written reference spec for ml_like + dynamic + host_gc. OCaml-flavored: `let`/`let rec`, pattern matching, ADTs, `match ... with`, strict evaluation, immutable bindings.

Subset edges (v1): no `when` guards on match arms, no mutual recursion (`let rec ... and ...`), no records, no `ref` cells, no modules/functors, no exceptions, no type checking (constructors are dynamic).
Iteration is recursion: there is no while/for loop. Pattern matching on `[]` and `h :: t` is the natural idiom for list traversal.
origin_story: A hand-built reference compiler in the ML family. Used as the template for every ml_like language Forge generates.
